title: Hazmat hood with respirator
concept: Soldiers in yellow hazmat suits sweeping a dark lab with torches.
sheet: Studio product photograph of a yellow rubberised hazmat hood that covers only the head, rounded like a diving helmet and ending in a short gathered ruff at the neck, no shoulders, no body: a full-face respirator built into it, a wide dark tinted visor and two round black filter canisters at the cheeks. Shown on its own, empty, as if worn by an invisible person, front three-quarter view. Whole object in frame with generous space around it, plain light grey seamless background, soft even studio light, no floor, no shadows, no text or logos.
notes: Budget: 2,000 triangles, 1K maps (a rigid part on the people skeleton's head bone, so head only: shoulders would clip when the head turns). Gameplay camera sees it at about 4 cm per pixel.
